book_title_ja: バガヴァッド・ギーター
title_ja_reading: バガヴァッド ギーター
author: Vyasa
book_description: The Bhagavad Gita. English verse translations from the Sargeant Sanskrit/English PDF form the source spine; Chinese and modern Japanese are generated for language-learning overlays.

preparation_notes.english_spine: English verse translation blocks are extracted from the Sargeant PDF, one chunk per verse page.
preparation_notes.sanskrit_reference: The Sargeant PDF includes Sanskrit, transliteration, word-by-word glosses, and grammar notes as reference only.
preparation_notes.chinese_reference: The Chinese PDF is scanned and retained as a source reference; OCR-polished Chinese can be added later without replacing existing chunks.
preparation_notes.japanese_reference: No Japanese source was supplied; generate natural modern Japanese.
